130: ### REQ-002: Capability and ownership boundaries
131: 
132: - SDD Core MUST own requirement/acceptance traceability, approval and lifecycle
133:   semantics, risk classification, evidence integrity, gate aggregation,
134:   compatibility rules, and the meaning of pass/fail/not-applicable/not-run.
135: - A target Capability MUST express target-neutral obligations for the artifact
136:   shape, questions/facets, and required verification types. It MUST NOT contain
137:   provider names, provider credentials, provider-specific resource state, or a
138:   duplicate gate registry.
139: - A Provider Binding/Adapter MUST own provider identity, resource references,
140:   credentials references, provider operations, and provider-reported real
141:   state. Shared Core MUST consume a normalized result envelope without
142:   claiming ownership of provider state.
143: - A Host Adapter MUST own runtime-specific manifests, invocation syntax, hooks,
144:   and capability-detection mechanics. Hosts MUST share the same workflow,
145:   approval, and evidence semantics.
146: - A project context MUST refer to provider bindings by ID and MUST NOT embed
147:   provider details, consistent with ADR-0018.
